Further up, Will Cockerell and Pete Willis were slugging it out ahead of an out of sorts John Kimaiyo. But on the final lap, up at the Miner’s Memorial again, it was noted that our Pete was also missing.

New Belgravian Conor McGee didn’t expect to know anyone but he and John Kimaiyo immediately recognised each other. Conor, who hails from Dublin, was out in Kenya a while back and trained at one of the camps with John Kimaiyo and others where Conor was given the name of Kipchumba.
